title: Implement Benefits section variants (benefits-icons, benefits-checklist)
description: Implement two Benefits section variants. benefits-icons shows benefits as icon cards. benefits-checklist shows benefits as a two-column checklist.
acceptanceCriteria: Both accept `{ content: BenefitsContent, business: BusinessInfo }` props
Both render all benefit items with title and description
benefits-icons shows a prominent icon above each benefit
benefits-checklist shows a checkmark icon before each benefit
Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

steps.details: Grid `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3`. Each item: large colored icon (--color-primary background circle), title (h3), description. Clean card layout.
Two-column grid on desktop, single on mobile. Each item: checkmark icon (--color-primary color), title (bold), description (muted). Dense, list-style layout.
Take Playwright screenshot. Verify icons/checkmarks are visible, text is readable.
